title: Evaluating LLM-Generated World Models for Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.14419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Formal world models can support planning, verification, and safety reasoning, but constructing them from open-ended natural-language situations is difficult, particularly in multi-agent settings where several formalizations may be plausible. We study whether five LLMs can generate such world models as partially observable stochastic games and whether mechanical validity is sufficient to establish that the resulting model faithfully represents the intended decision problem. We introduce a benchmark of 44 scenarios spanning game, situational, and cultural settings and evaluate generated world models along three dimensions: mechanical validity, reference-relative structural agreement, and semantic criteria. Across three empirical tracks, we analyze 410 first-pass generations. translated_title: 评估用于神经符号推理的LLM生成世界模型
translated_abstract: 形式化世界模型可以支持规划、验证和安全推理，但从开放式的自然语言情境中构建这些模型是困难的，尤其是在多个形式化方案都可能成立的多智能体场景中。我们研究了五个大语言模型（LLM）能否将此类世界模型生成为部分可观测随机博弈（POSG），以及机械有效性是否足以证明所得模型忠实地表示了预期的决策问题。我们引入了一个包含44个场景的基准，涵盖博弈、情境和文化类设置，并从三个维度评估生成的世界模型：机械有效性、相对于参考模型的结构一致性，以及语义标准。在三个实证轨道中，我们分析了410个首次生成的世界模型。在有参考模型的博弈轨道中，135个生成的世界模型中有134个通过了严格的机械审计，然而平均置换不变结构F1仅为0.366，这仅……
tldr: 该研究通过一个涵盖44个场景的基准评估五个大语言模型生成的世界模型，发现尽管135个生成模型中有134个通过了严格的机械有效性审计，但其与参考模型的结构一致性平均F1仅为0.366，表明机械有效性并不足以保证世界模型忠实地表示预期的决策问题。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a benchmark of 44 scenarios to evaluate LLM-generated world models, finding that although 134 out of 135 generated models pass a strict mechanical validity audit, their mean structural agreement with reference models is only 0.366 F1, showing that mechanical validity alone is insufficient to guarantee faithful representation of the intended decision problem.
